resources.string: It walks your avatar from one Big Flower to the next with a simulated walk, writes the distance to Health Connect as steps, and takes you home whenever you like.
Open the menu → Setup, and tick each step. Nothing moves until it is done.
Long-press the map to add a Big Flower, or bring one in from the menu item \"Find nearby candidate Big Flowers\".
Press it and the patrol starts along your patrol route.
When you are not on patrol, a Start patrol button sits below the main screen; press it and the patrol starts along your patrol route.

Menu → \"Home locations…\" saves a few homes (for example places you visit often). When you tap \"Go home\", you can walk back to your real location or to one of the homes; once you arrive, the avatar stops there. A patrol always starts from your real location and never teleports to a home.
This is the floating bar\'s handle: tap to open, hold to drag.\n▶ pause and resume, 🏠 go home, ■ stop, 🎮 joystick…
Once a patrol starts, the floating bar appears with pause, home, stop and more.

🤖 Auto actions: on the game\'s expedition list it sends fruit and seedling expeditions; on the feed screen it auto-feeds nectar. The first time, it asks you to turn on the accessibility service; stop it from the notification.
